summary.text: Cooke Harvey is an independent candidate in Virginia's 5th Congressional District who has not previously held office. According to Cville Right Now, he is originally from Delaware, has worked in engineering, surveying and wilderness therapy with at-risk youth, and qualified for the ballot with the required 1,000 signatures. He has said he does not accept monetary donations.

paragraphs.text: Originally from Delaware; his experience includes engineering and surveying and work in wilderness therapy with at-risk youth, the vocation that brought him to Virginia. He did not attend a traditional college, according to Cville Right Now.

Gathered the 1,000 certified signatures from registered Virginia voters needed to appear on the November 3, 2026 ballot as an independent. He told Cville Right Now he and the other independent adopted a policy of not accepting monetary donations.
